header.contentDescription: Drag to grow a branching fungal network from a single spore

drawTextAnchored.text: the tips are where everything happens - the old network is plumbing
A fungus has no mouth. It grows into its food and digests it outside itself,
so the body and the feeding apparatus are the same object - which is why size has no
fixed limit, and the largest known organism on Earth is one of these.
